name: enterprise-genai-platform
description: Multi-tenant GenAI platform: LLM gateway, RAG, agents and MCP gateway on NestJS.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @genai/shared && npm run build -w @genai/auth && npm run build -w @genai/guardrails && npm run build -w @genai/observability && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @genai/shared && npm run build -w @genai/auth && npm run build -w @genai/guardrails && npm run build -w @genai/observability && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @genai/shared && npm run build -w @genai/auth && npm run build -w @genai/guardrails && npm run build -w @genai/observability && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.eval: npm run build -w @genai/shared && npm run build -w @genai/auth && npm run build -w @genai/guardrails && npm run build -w @genai/observability && npm run eval -w @genai/evals
scripts.eval:selftest: npm run build -w @genai/shared && npm run build -w @genai/auth && npm run build -w @genai/guardrails && npm run build -w @genai/observability && npm run eval:selftest -w @genai/evals
scripts.eval:baseline: npm run build -w @genai/shared && npm run build -w @genai/auth && npm run build -w @genai/guardrails && npm run build -w @genai/observability && npm run eval:baseline -w @genai/evals
